regime.genre: multi-domain benchmark sample (abstracts, books, news, poetry)

generator.vintage: 2022-2023 (generators in the RAID release; Dugan et al. 2024)

human_population.determined_how: Dataset documentation (RAID paper, Dugan et al. 2024): human texts sourced from arXiv abstracts, books, news, poetry and other upstream corpora; no per-author demographics recorded

drops_manifest.reason: preliminary sample only (n=6000 normalised rows from 2270000 split rows)
measured on the local interpreter only; CI covers the matrix
no threshold was fitted on this sample; AUROC/TPR@FPR are threshold-free
this seed record reports one pooled slice per dataset; finer slices are wave-2 work

run.reporting_rules: Labelled rows only; abstentions counted separately from AUROC/TPR (abstained rows still contribute their score); no score threshold fitted — AUROC and TPR@FPR are threshold-free; native FPR/TPR at the detector's native categorical verdict; bootstrap 95% CIs, 1000 resamples, seed 20261108

fpr_native.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text); no score threshold

known_failure_modes: heuristic score distributions for human and machine text overlap heavily (AUROC 0.5958 on this sample)
adversarial attack variants (whitespace, case, paragraph insertion, article deletion) are pooled into this slice and not reported separately
limitations: not validated for texts below 80 words (the detector's minimum)
not validated for generators newer than the record's declared vintage
not validated for human populations outside the record's declared population
no reviewer has assessed this record; it is a preliminary seed, not a reviewed validation
the sample is a strided subset of the split, not a full-corpus evaluation
near-duplicate rate was not measured for this sample

contamination_flag is 'no' because the builtin detector is a hand-written stylometric heuristic with no training: it was not trained on this dataset or on any other text corpus, so it cannot have memorised evaluation rows
attack slices are not reported separately in this record (wave-2 concern)
the strided sample covers only the domains observed in the cache (abstracts, books, news, poetry); other RAID domains are not represented in this sample
this sample supersedes the U1 3000-row sample (evr-20261106-raid-builtin-heuristic); the U1 cache is preserved and the two samples are disjoint by content hash
phase-shifted strided sample (n=6000, +189 rows; human density 0.0285)
native false-positive rate is 0.0 on this sample (0 of 171 human rows verdict ai_like at the native operating point)
